③ Factor engine & factor pool — factors/
123+ factors validated locally (PIT, T+1, per year): turnover · low-vol · reversal · Amihud liquidity
lottery / skew · F-score · SUE · limit-up/down · Dragon-Tiger institutions · industry crowding · Alpha101

+ traffic light, policy and calendar hooks
Each card: score · win-rate · evidence chain ·
40-day cycle, T+1, no stops, no timing
Drops ETFs correlated > 0.85 with each other
Reference only, never a buy signal
⑧ Risk gate — risk/ (holds veto power)
RiskAgent order: circuit breaker → drawdown tiers 5/10/15% → single trade → per-name cap 10%
→ industry cap 30% → total position. If risk itself fails: safe mode (no new buys, reduce only).
Stops: hard −7% · ATR×2 · 3-week time stop · MA50 trailing · −8% off the high · take-profit 20–25%
Screens: Beneish M-score (earnings manipulation) · fake-signal detector · data audit · factor health
Approve buy / drop on each card → recorded in deck_decisions
Buy list = aggregation of approved L2 cards (one source, no second recommender)
You place the order yourself at your broker, at the next day's open (T+1). There is no broker adapter.
Five pools, tracked the same way: A auto_pitch · B machine_top01 · C human_select · D ai_select · ★ niu_select
update_fwd() fills T+1 / T+5 / T+20 / T+60 returns daily; summaries per pool and per 牛散 persona
Results flow back into factor-pool verdicts, so weak factors and bad habits get demoted

Web deck — deck/deck_server.py at http://127.0.0.1:8787 (Python stdlib HTTP server)
Every engine step writes JSON into logs/ and output/ → /api/* serves the newest timestamped file · /api/live/* computes live views · /api/proxy/* forwards to HARNESS :3080
ui_v2 pages fetch everything through LW.api.get (no hard-coded business data):
A TRADING DAY · the author's scheduled jobs (Windows Task Scheduler)

The repo ships these scripts but does not register the jobs (schtasks). On macOS/Linux run them by hand or schedule them with cron / launchd. Fetching only needs to happen once a day, after the close.
